response_text: {"decomposition_id":"D9","label":"Board Governance Meta-Duty: Approve, Review, and Oversee","object":"the board's recurring meta-duty to approve governance frameworks, review them at least annually, and receive reports across risk, capital, strategy, and audit domains","consolidated_text":"The board (or, where an operand so provides, a designated board-level committee) shall exercise a recurring oversight meta-duty comprising three functions across the bank's risk-governance, capital-adequacy and capital-planning, strategic-planning, stress-testing, audit, credit, and asset-liability domains. First, the board shall approve the governing frameworks, policies, strategies, and risk appetites for each such domain — including requiring management to establish and then approving a formal written risk-governance framework, approving the three-year strategic plan with its risk assessment, approving capital-planning policies and activities, approving written stress-testing policies, giving final approval to written policies and setting a clear risk appetite and strategic objectives, and, through the relevant board-level committees, establishing lending strategy and credit risk appetite/limits (credit committee) and asset-liability strategies, rate-risk appetites, and limits (ALCO). Second, the board or its designated committee shall review these frameworks and policies at least annually and, where applicable, before submission — including reviewing the robustness of capital-adequacy assessment, reviewing capital-planning policies annually, annually reviewing stress-testing policies, and reviewing/approving credit and liquidity exposures within the committees' remit. Third, the board and its committees shall receive and monitor reports on implementation and performance — including monitoring strategic-plan implementation, overseeing the audit program and confirming comprehensive coverage while holding management accountable for internal controls, and receiving functional reporting from the chief audit executive to the audit committee on the audit plan and findings.
